content.short: Mercury is a US business banking platform for startups and tech companies with accounts, cards and treasury.
content.description: Mercury, founded in 2017, is a US business banking platform widely used by startups and technology companies to run their finances from one well-designed dashboard. Through partner banks it provides business checking and savings accounts, treasury products that move idle cash into money-market funds and Treasuries, corporate and virtual cards, domestic and international payments, and bill pay, with API access and workflow tools for finance teams. Mercury targets founders and scaling companies that want modern, software-first banking with strong controls and visibility rather than legacy business banking. By combining accounts, cards, payments and treasury in a clean product, it has become a default financial hub for many venture-backed startups.
